name: pathfinder
description: Map an unfamiliar repository, create a bounded Goal, or run one explicitly authorized controller-backed mission to review.

interface.shortDescription: Map a repo, pick the next move, write the goal
interface.longDescription: Pathfinder opens a chooser for source-first repo exploration, a fast prompt-to-goal route, explicitly authorized controller-backed autonomous work in an isolated worktree, creator model refresh, and status/help. It saves a bounded native Goal or fallback implementation goal. /pathfinder auto requires fresh per-run authorization, complete doctrine context, and an enforceable runtime boundary, and stops publication at awaiting-review.
defaultPrompt: Use the pathfinder skill on this repository. Start the full Pathfinder process.
Map this codebase and propose the highest-value next move.
Generate a bounded /goal for the work we just scoped.
Run Pathfinder autonomously on this repository with /pathfinder auto.
Refresh the Pathfinder creator model with /pathfinder charter.
Turn this prompt into a runnable /goal: <describe the work you want done>.
